title: peer_registry positional column access fragile across schema changes
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/peer_registry.rs, get() and list_active() use positional column access (r.get(0), r.get(1), ...) to decode query results. Positional access breaks silently when a migration reorders columns or adds a column in the middle. Use named column access via sqlx::query_as or r.get("column_name").
